newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares to again take cue from Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: German shares to again take cue from Wall Street.

text.p: German shares will again take their cue from Wall Street in afternoon dealings on Thursday after the DAX index, fueled by Allianz AG, earlier in the day, hurdled the key 3,000-point level in bourse dealings.
Dealings in particular said the market will focus on the release at 1330 GMT of U.S. weekly jobless claims data.
The 30-share DAX index ended up 18.12 points at 3,017.32 points, buoyed by gains in DAX heavyweight Allianz AG.
Goldman Sachs raised its rating on the German insurer, sparking a rally in Allianz that saw its shares rise some five percent to a new record high at 3,085 marks.
